highlights_headline: The next release adds experimental image comparisons and fixes runtime-effect uniforms, texture sampling, and Windows image-decoding crashes.
highlights_body: SkiaSharp.Testing provides configurable image comparisons and visual difference diagnostics. Linux x86 native assets are no longer packaged; applications targeting that architecture must move to a supported architecture.

breaking.title: Move Linux x86 applications to a supported architecture
breaking.body: Linux x86 native assets are no longer built or included in NuGet packages. Retarget applications that depend on those assets to a supported architecture before upgrading.

bullets.detail: SkiaSharp.Testing compares SKImage, SKBitmap, and SKPixmap inputs with channel tolerances, masks, mismatch budgets, and error metrics, and creates visual difference images. The assembly is experimental: consumers opt in by suppressing SKIA4001. Returned difference images are caller-owned and must be disposed.

Fixes process crashes during libjpeg/libpng error recovery in Windows x64 clang builds, including PDF output with lazy non-JPEG images and malformed JPEG input to SKCodec.Create. Windows arm64, x86, and MSVC builds are unchanged.

New SKRuntimeEffectUniforms buffers now start at zero instead of containing uninitialized data. Reset() clears the existing buffer in place, restoring documented zero values without allocating a replacement native buffer and wrapper.
Linear filtering clamps samples slightly inside texture-subset edges to avoid including undefined exterior texels. Ganesh texture-edge pixels may change; CPU and Graphite rendering are unaffected.

Tizen now applies its intended CPU blur configuration to Skia itself, selecting the existing ThreeBoxApprox/Tent paths instead of the shader-based Gaussian candidate. Blur pixels and performance may differ; Tizen rendering and performance were not measured in the source change.

contributor_summaries.taublast: Fixed runtime-effect uniform initialization and in-place reset, and disposed test snapshots.
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored the Uno Gallery to the Windows sample solution.
contributor_summaries.SimonCropp: Fixed Windows x64 crashes during JPEG and PNG decoder error recovery.
